The prices in full detail

Why it costs 4 to 5 times less

A showcase website made by hand by a freelancer usually costs between €1,500 and €3,000, and often more at an agency. Yours costs €500, and here is why.

Lia does the heavy lifting

Our AI builds the pages, writes the code and suggests the first texts in a few hours. By hand, this work takes weeks.

Alex checks everything by hand

I review every page, test the website on a phone and fix whatever needs fixing. Nothing goes online without my check.

The price is shown

It is written on the website, and it is the same for every client. You do not wait for a quote.

You pay for the time spent

A few hours for Lia, a real review by Alex. That is where the price difference comes from, and nowhere else.

SEO

SEO is my thing

SEO is what makes your website appear on Google when someone searches for what you do.

Example: someone types “plumber Charleville” on their phone. If your website is well prepared, it shows up in the top results. They click, they call you, and not your competitor.

To do this, I prepare your website from the start: the right words in titles and text, a fast website, a Google listing. These basics are included. With the Ongoing SEO extra, at €10 a month, I keep improving it for Google, month after month.

  • TechnicalFast, secure, perfect on mobile.
  • LocalGoogle listing, reviews, pages for your towns.
  • ContentUseful text, written for your customers.
  • TrackingRankings and visits every month, with the Ongoing SEO extra.
